Agentic advertising changes what's possible, which also changes what can go wrong.
Boltive's Agentic Governance Engine verifies creatives and inventory before autonomous systems act. Built on a decade of ad security and privacy technology, Boltive enables confident transactions at scale.

get your free scan

Humans are no longer part of every decision. Boltive keeps governance in the loop.

Agentic systems make decisions at machine speed, often across environments no one team fully controls. Boltive verifies creatives and inventory before those decisions are made, helping ensure every transaction aligns with your standards.

Confidence before agents act

Boltive helps buyer and seller agents make safer decisions before a transaction moves forward. The Agentic Governance Engine evaluates creatives and inventory against security, quality, content, and policy requirements, then returns a clear decision signal: approve, reject, or escalate.

Privacy Compliance

A consent string set correctly in an API call doesn't mean your users stopped being tracked. Personas make real privacy choices on your site, then reveal what actually happens downstream - across every partner, every data collector, every handoff in the chain.

Ad Security

Bad actors invest heavily in filtering out bots so they only deliver payloads to real people. Our Personas get past those filters. That means the threats they surface are the same threats your users face - nothing sanitized, nothing hidden.

What Boltive Delivers

Prove Compliance

Verify consent, data sharing, and digital behavior with clear, defensible evidence.

Protect Revenue

Stop bad ads, broken signals, and unwanted behavior before they cost you revenue.

Behavior That Looks Human

Patented Personas behave like real users, uncovering risks  scanners and bots miss.

Reduce Blind Spots

Get clear visibility across vendors, advertising systems, and third-party technology.

Built for the whole team.
Built for the whole portfolio.

Boltive puts privacy, legal, marketing, and ad ops on the same page — same data, same language, same framework – that works for global scale.

Agentic Governance

Govern autonomous advertising systems before they act. Boltive validates creatives, inventory, and downstream behavior in production, applying machine-actionable rules and producing defensible audit evidence at machine speed.

Frequently asked questions

Everything you need to know about Boltive, our technology, and how we help reduce digital risk.

Still have questions?
Contact Us
What does Boltive do?

Boltive helps companies govern privacy, ad security, and agentic advertising. Our technology gives teams visibility into digital behavior, identifies risk, and helps verify that established rules are being followed.

Who uses Boltive?

Boltive is used by brands, publishers, ad platforms, law firms, and consultancies. Teams across privacy, legal, marketing, AdOps, security, and compliance use Boltive to better understand and control complex digital environments.

What problems does Boltive help solve?

Boltive helps uncover issues such as broken consent flows, unauthorized data sharing, malicious or unwanted ads, advertising quality problems, and governance gaps in increasingly automated advertising systems.

How is Boltive different from traditional scanning tools?

Boltive simulates real user experiences to reveal behavior that basic scanners and configuration checks can miss. This provides a more complete view of what users, advertisers, and partners are actually experiencing.

What solutions does Boltive offer?

Boltive offers Privacy Guard for digital privacy governance, Ad Lightning for ad security and quality, and governance capabilities designed for the emerging agentic advertising ecosystem.

Does Boltive replace the technology we already use?

No. Boltive works alongside existing systems such as CMPs, tag managers, ad platforms, and other privacy and advertising technology, providing an additional layer of visibility, validation, and governance.
